key.name: same_product
key.script: {row.order_id: row.product_id for row in orders}[order_id] == {row.lot_id: row.product_id for row in lots}[lot_id]

key.name: days_to_expiry
key.script: ({row.lot_id: row.expires_on for row in lots}[lot_id] - {row.order_id: row.ship_on for row in orders}[order_id]).days

key.name: lot_allocated
key.script: sum(row.quantity for row in allocations if row.lot_id == lot_id)

key.name: lots_of_order
key.script: len({row.lot_id for row in allocations if row.order_id == order_id})

key.name: shipped
key.script: sum(row.quantity for row in allocations if row.order_id == order_id)

key.name: valid_left
key.script: sum(lot.quantity - sum(row.quantity for row in allocations if row.lot_id == lot.lot_id) for lot in lots if lot.product_id == product_id and ship_on <= lot.expires_on)
